LanguageData.RKU_Faction.label: Ratkin Underground Partisans
LanguageData.RKU_Faction.ideoDescription: \n These underground Ratkin originated from the remnants of the Revolutionary Army defeated by the Kingdom a decade ago. They once controlled half of the Kingdom's territories, including the capital. However, the Revolutionary Army fragmented due to the outbreak of the biochemical Ratkin Pestis and the corruption of its leadership, with most units breaking away to become warlords. Ten years have passed, and various warlords and aristocrats still plague these chaotic regions. Only one unit from the eastern front of the Revolutionary Army has maintained its original structure. They have occupied a Kingdom vehicle factory, producing drillers to conduct underground guerrilla warfare. This force aims to save civilians and end the civil war, but they are undermanned, poorly equipped, and isolated.\n
